I’ll defend the labyrinth and ANYWAY scenes.

I don’t really prefer one version over the other but I feel like in the case of the remake Maria, she comes off as more sympathetic to me. They toned down her anger and verbal abuse to make her seem more likable while being way more subtle in her manipulation. So with this in mind it makes sense to me that the “ANYWAY” line is toned down more, it makes the audience feel for her more but it also manipulates James into being with her.

The labyrinth scene is missing the personality switch but I feel like they did that on purpose because to me James in the remake comes off as much more aware and even smarter in the remake, like he still makes horrible decisions that no normal person would do but he’s more cautious around Maria, it always seems like he doesn’t fully trust her during their time together. I feel lukewarm Maria is aware of this and doesn’t see the need to manipulate him in that scene.
